description: CI gate: run a full scan and return an exit code (1 when findings at or above the fail_on severity exist). Pair with SARIF output for pipelines.

fail_on.description: Severity threshold that fails the build (default high)

format.description: Also return a rendered report under 'report' (sarif for pipelines)

path.description: File, directory, or archive (tar.gz/zip) to scan

tools.description: Subset: exposure, secrets, code, deps, iocs

name: ci_scan
